purpose: Ten memorable named non-legendary residents in sparse parts of the map. Terrain explains each creature; none is a quest or shrine.

rules.keeper: Reuse the persistent resident/guardian pattern. Never replace or despawn an entity tagged cobblers.guardian; blackout recovery belongs to that exact Pokemon.
rules.aggression: Bounded local trigger and leash; never change Fight or Flight behavior for the species globally.
rules.reexport: Reapply from source after export through the established RCON resident path, then verify UUID, species, level, persistence, catch rule, trigger and leash.

build.status: built_not_placed 2026-10-02: generated by tools/resident_encounters.py into build/datapacks/cobblers_residents, audited offline by tools/resident_encounters_audit.py; re-application step R18R. Not applied to any world; nothing here was observed in game

keeper.why: the Ursaluna keeper's 40-tick schedule loop and the gulch Megas' respawn clock (tools/gulch_mine.py megas/keep_*), one keep function per resident run only while its anchor's chunk is loaded. The clock is the game time the resident was first seen gone on two passes in a row (entities load a moment after their chunk), and only the keeper writes it. A resident comes back respawn ticks later, only when a player (holding its appears_after flag, if it has one) is within spawn_radius of the anchor and NO player is within spawn_clear, so it is never conjured in front of anyone. Awake, it settles back onto its spot asleep when no player is within leash + settle_margin

build.trigger_rule: a STATE CHECK on the keeper's loop, the sleeping Celebi's and the Ursaluna's mechanism, never an advancement: while DORMANT (tag cobblers.res_dormant: NoAI, held on its spot, facing its yaw) the first non-spectator player within `trigger` blocks of the anchor wakes it (NoAI off, the message, the sound). Awake it moves under its own AI and Fight or Flight's GLOBAL config, which this pack never touches (rules.aggression); the leash teleports it back to the anchor whenever it is more than `leash` blocks out. Cobblemon 1.8.0 has no command that starts a battle with a wild Pokemon (data/ursaluna_cave.json wake.start_why), so 'trigger' is the wake, not a forced battle
build.appears_after_rule: the record's gate is a PRESENCE gate where the brief says the resident appears after it (Wiremother: 'the resident appears after gym3_cleared'), and for every resident whose intended_stage is at or after its gate. It is not one for Old Jaw (intended_stage pre_gym_1 with gate gym1_cleared: the gate is its CATCH gate, the level-cap refusal, and the brief makes it the danger a fresh player meets) or Whiteback (gate null). A shared world resident cannot be hidden per player: the first time a player holding the flag comes within spawn_radius it appears FOR THE SERVER, and stays, as the woken Celebi stays for everyone (docs/mechanics/CELEBI_WAKE.md 5)
build.catch_rule_mechanism: permanently_uncatchable: the spawn property `uncatchable` (EXP-023: holds across a restart; it cannot be cleared on a spawned Pokemon, data/sapling_celebi.json). Every other resident is catchable, and its gate on catching is the existing level-cap refusal (data/level_cap.json: a catch strictly above the thrower's RCT cap is refused), per thrower, so it holds in a shared world: each resident's level is above every cap a player can have before its gate and within the cap bound after it (data/trainers.json gym_ace_levels and the league's teams; tools/resident_encounters_audit.py recomputes this). Those caps are UPPER bounds: a player still owing a route trainer after the gate has a lower cap and is refused until they beat it
build.blackout_decision: a resident that beats or kills a player is an ordinary wild victor to the blackout system (data/blackout.json claims): it makes the item claim and becomes that claim's guardian (tag cobblers.guardian), and beating, catching or killing it returns the items. It is NOT exempt like the gulch Megas (claims.exempt_tag cobblers.gm): Codex's old_jaw_blackout_check plans exactly this ('returned by defeating or catching the same guardian') and rules.keeper says recovery belongs to that exact Pokemon. So this pack never adds cobblers.gm and, from the moment a resident carries cobblers.guardian, never touches it again: no leash, no wake or settle, no teleport, no NBT merge and never a kill (the duplicate rule kills only tag=!cobblers.guardian). The blackout's own leash (claims.guardian_leash 24, to the claim's site) and maintenance own it. It still counts as present, so no second resident spawns beside it; and a guardian the blackout REBUILT (recovery/rebuild_as, which does not carry our tag) counts too, found by tag cobblers.guardian and species within leash + guardian_search_margin of the anchor. When it is beaten, caught or killed the claim settles and the respawn clock starts
build.drops_rule: no loot drops: nothing in this pack gives, loots or summons an item, and the residents carry no reward record. Cobblemon's own species drop table is not touched and whether it fires on a battle knock-out is NOT VERIFIED (a world probe in the doc)
build.lighting: dark by design: wild sites with no settlement, lit by nothing but the day (one lantern on River Grip's observation post)
build.sound_and_message_why: placeholders in plain words; the voice is Codex's
